description: Fix CropService.getCropsByFarmer bug where userId is passed instead of farmerId. The method signature accepts Long farmerId but CropController.getMyCrops passes userId from the authenticated User. Must resolve Farmer entity from userId first, then query crops by the Farmer's ID using cropRepository.findByFarmerId.
steps: Read c:\25EG505V04\AgriBridge\Farmer-to-Market Management Platform\backend\src\main\java\com\agribridge\service\CropService.java to understand current implementation
Read c:\25EG505V04\AgriBridge\Farmer-to-Market Management Platform\backend\src\main\java\com\agribridge\controller\CropController.java to confirm how getMyCrops calls the service
Read c:\25EG505V04\AgriBridge\Farmer-to-Market Management Platform\backend\src\main\java\com\agribridge\repository\CropRepository.java and FarmerRepository.java to verify available query methods

Modify CropService.getCropsByFarmer(Long userId): change logic to first call farmerRepository.findByUserId(userId).orElseThrow(), then return cropRepository.findByFarmerId(farmer.getId()). This returns all crops (available and unavailable) for the farmer's dashboard.
Verify the farmerRepository field already exists in CropService (injected via constructor)
Compile backend with mvn clean compile to ensure no syntax errors
Commit the fix locally with message 'fix: resolve userId to farmerId in CropService.getCropsByFarmer'
acceptance_criteria: CropService.getCropsByFarmer accepts userId and resolves to Farmer entity before querying crops
Backend compiles successfully with mvn clean compile
No ResourceNotFoundException thrown when Farmer profile exists for the user
verification: Run mvn clean compile in backend directory - must show BUILD SUCCESS

Use Swagger UI at http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html to test: POST /api/auth/login with {phone: 9876543210, password: Farmer@123}, copy JWT token, authorize in Swagger, call GET /api/crops/my-crops - must return 200 OK with farmer's crops array (may be empty if no crops exist, but not 500 error)
findings: Fix successfully applied. CropService.getCropsByFarmer now correctly resolves userId to Farmer entity first, then queries crops by farmerId. Backend compiles successfully with BUILD SUCCESS.
